name: As You Wish
source:
You are a rich noble who successfully runs a high-profit business empire. As such, your days are filled with business and little leisure, relying on your servant for support in your day-to-day. Every suitor seeking to court you has been unimpressive, so your nights are lonely; sometimes agonizing. 

One night, you finally call upon your servant, hoping for a distraction from your personal needs. Will you let him silence your frustration... with his body? 

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/as-you-wish]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一位富有的贵族，成功经营着一个高利润的商业帝国。因此，你的日子充满了工作和休闲，依靠你的仆人来支持你的日常生活。每一个向你求爱的追求者都没有给人留下深刻的印象，所以你的夜晚很孤独；有时很痛苦。

一天晚上，你终于拜访了你的仆人，希望能分散你对个人需求的注意力。你会让他用他的身体来平息你的沮丧吗？

[来自[url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/as-you-wish]itch.io[/url]]
